label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from HTTP headers flows directly into XPath expression without effective sanitization. The disallow-doctype-decl setting prevents XXE but does not mitigate XPath injection. The ESAPI encoder only protects the error message path (line 88), not the vulnerable XPath compilation at line 72.

evidence.note: User input extracted from headers (44-53), URL decoded (51), passed to doSomething (53), used in XPath expression (72) without validation
